items.title: Special termination of electricity contract due to price increase
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The provider grants a special right of termination because of the price change effective 01.01.2027. The letter states the cancellation must reach the provider 'vor diesem Tag' (before 01.01.2027), i.e. at the latest on the day before, 31.12.2026. This is a contractual/notice deadline, which under German law (BGH III ZR 172/04) is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend or holiday. 31.12.2026 is a Thursday, so no adjustment is needed. Final day the cancellation must arrive: 31.12.2026.
